description: Save an edited text of simulation.yaml with the stamp that GET api/config gave: the launcher's check says that it runs the same commands as the saved file, so it is saved by default. The answer has the stamp of what was saved.

body.text:
# A configuration of the GUI server's tests: replay_launcher.py plays what the real launcher wrote for it
# (recordings/, made by record_launcher.py: record again after changing this file).
vehicle_sil_simulation: 2

networks:
  - name: J1939_CAN
    kind: can
participants:
  - name: Engine
    command: [engine/vehicle_sil_engine_ecu]
  - name: Dashboard
    command: [dashboard/vehicle_sil_dashboard_ecu]
  - name: Logger
    command: [logger/can_logger, "{registry_uri}"]
    describe: false
    required: false
# saved from the screen
